# root-export-string-apply

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0`

# dsh-plugin-toolkit

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
[![CI](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](LICENSE)


![dsh-plugin-toolkit](docs/card.png)

English · [中文](./README.zh.md)

Everything a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin needs between `init` and a version the market index accepts: scaffolding, a test harness for the client bundle, a way to see a change without restarting the app, and a release that does not depend on remembering fourteen steps.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel   # a plugin that already passes the checks
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest verify .                          # pack it, install the tarball, mount the panel
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest release --pr --merge              # tag, wait for npm, update the index, open and merge the PR
```

## The panel

![The Plugin doctor tab, on a plugin that fails two checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/panel.png)

The same checks, in the right sidebar: type a folder, an `owner/repo`, or a GitHub link, and it says which one would fail and why. Nothing is installed and nothing is written.

## Three paths

| You are… | Start with | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| writing your first plugin | [`init`](#1-write-a-plugin) | `doctor`, `fix`, `verify` |
| changing a panel that is already installed | [`dev`](#2-develop-a-panel) | `mount`, the testkit, `audit` |
| shipping a version | [`verify`](#3-ship-a-version) | `release`, `index` |

It also installs as a plugin. `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-toolkit` puts a
**插件体检 / Plugin doctor** panel under the conversation and a tab in the right
sidebar. Give it a folder that holds a plugin's `package.json`, or just
`owner/repo` — or a repository name, which it searches GitHub for and lists the
candidates to pick from. It then runs the same checks `verify` runs and says
which one would break the install, with the reason on the line — the same
answers as the CLI, without leaving the app.

```
$ dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-toolkit
```

### 1. Write a plugin

[`init`](#start-from-a-plugin-that-already-passes) writes the files whose absence shows up as a failed first publish — `engines.dsh`, the patch file, a `files` list that ships the code, a client bundle, a test for it, and the CI that runs both. `doctor` then checks the same things without writing anything, and [`verify`](#prove-the-tarball-works-not-just-the-repository) checks the tarball instead of the working copy.

If a plugin already exists, `doctor --fix` turns the failing checks into a
repair plan. It names the file and the edit for every problem, writes nothing
until you add `--write`, and then runs the checks again. `fix --engines` is
still there when the host range is the only thing you need to change.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel
cd my-panel && npm install && npm test && npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest doctor .
```

### 2. Develop a panel

A plugin's client code is one file that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({factory})` — there is no module to import, so the usual React test setup does not apply. [`testkit`](#test-a-panel-without-a-browser) supplies the missing half, and [`dev`](#edit-a-plugin-that-is-already-installed) pushes a rebuilt bundle into the running app.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest mount ./client.js     # what a user would see, without the app
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
```

### 3. Ship a version

`verify` first (it is the only check that reads the tarball), then `release`, which tags, waits for the registry, writes the index entry with the publish time the registry reports, and — with `--pr --merge` — opens and merges the pull request.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest verify .
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest release . --pr --merge
```

## What `verify` actually does

![Five steps, and the failure each one catches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/pipeline.svg)

The order matters. Packing first means the check reads the file list npm will publish, not the folder you have. Installing the tarball means the root export is imported the way the loader imports it. Mounting means the client bundle is actually executed, in jsdom, with a host that records what it registered.

Each step exists because a plugin once got past the step before it and still installed into nothing.

## Why this exists

Releasing one plugin fifteen times taught me three things the ecosystem's tooling does not cover:

1. **A version is not shipped when npm accepts it.** Registry propagation took two to eight minutes every time. `npm view` answered from a stale local cache, so I repeatedly believed a release had failed when it had not — and once believed it had succeeded when the market still could not see it.
2. **The market index is a second release, done by hand.** Each version needs an entry carrying `publishTimestamp` from the registry and `engines.dsh` from the manifest. Forget the range and the index validator rejects the PR with `Engines mismatch` — after the tag is already public.
3. **Reading a manifest is not the same as checking it.** A plugin can have a valid `package.json` and still be uninstallable: `files` that omit the entry the manifest points at, a bundle patch that does not exist, a README that never states the host range it declares.

The five failures behind these checks — a red dot with no panel, a row the host drops, an app that disables every plugin after one unguarded `apply()`, a tab nothing can open, and a checker that was wrong — are written up with their exact error text and how to reproduce each one: [Five plugins that installed and did nothing](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/blob/main/docs/why-it-exists.md).

### Four ways a plugin installs and still does nothing

Each of these shipped in a real version of this toolkit before the check below existed. A manifest check passes on all four.

| What you see | What it was | Caught by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The tab is a red dot and the panel never opens | `exports["."]` pointed at the CLI, so the loader's row had no plugin to apply | `root export` |
| The plugin is installed, the app never serves it | `dsh.client` declared, `exports["./client"]` missing — the host drops the row | `client declaration` |
| The app says the third-party plugin is unsupported and disables all of them | `apply()` read `ctx.webServer` without declaring it; cordis throws instead of returning `undefined` | `verify` (calls `apply` on a context that has no services) |
| The tab registers, and nothing in the UI opens it | `sidebarRightTabs.register()` registers a *type*; the sidebar lists what `tabs.guide()` returns | a testkit test, not `doctor` |

The first three are static: `doctor` and `verify` catch them without the app running. The fourth is a UI contract, so it needs the panel mounted and the registration inspected — that is what [`testkit`](#test-a-panel-without-a-browser) is for.

## Requirements

- Node.js 18 or newer (the registry is read with `fetch`; no runtime dependencies)
- Git and `gh` on `PATH` for the steps that touch GitHub
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0` — the version whose market index carries `engines.dsh`, which is what makes the range check meaningful
- For `testkit`: `jsdom`, `react` and `react-dom` as dev dependencies (`npm install --save-dev jsdom react react-dom`)

## Start from a plugin that already passes

```sh
$ npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel --title "My panel"
created 8 file(s) in /Users/you/my-panel
  .github/workflows/ci.yml
  .gitignore
  README.md
  client.js
  cordis.patch.yml
  index.js
  package.json
  test/panel.test.mjs

next: npm install && npm test && npm run doctor
```

What you get is not a snippet: it is a plugin whose `doctor` already passes (`engines.dsh`, the patch file, the `files` list), with a client bundle that registers a sidebar tab, a testkit test for it, and a CI workflow that runs both. `init` refuses a directory that is not empty unless you pass `--force`, and refuses a name npm would refuse — those are the two mistakes that cost the most time later.

## Where it lives

The checker is docked **under the conversation**, above the input bar: a single
row, collapsed by default. Open it and it carries the whole guide — who it is
for, how to use it, what each check means, and what it cannot tell you — plus
the folder field and the results. The same panel is also a **Plugin doctor** tab
in the right sidebar, for when the conversation is busy.

The panel speaks both languages and opens in Chinese; the 中文 / EN switch sits
in the dock's header row (and in the sidebar tab) and the choice is remembered.

Look at it without the app:

```sh
node scripts/preview.mjs /tmp/panel.html   # collapsed, open, with a result, and the tab
```

## Test a panel without a browser

A plugin's client code is one file that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({factory})` — there is no module to import, so the usual React test setup does not apply. `testkit` supplies the missing half: a DOM, the real React, and a host context that records what the panel registers.

```sh
npm install --save-dev jsdom react react-dom
```

```js
import { mountClient, createFetch } from 'dsh-plugin-toolkit/testkit';

const panel = await mountClient({
  file: 'client.js',
  copy: { 'my-plugin': { title: 'My panel' } },
  fetch: createFetch({
    '/my-plugin/report': { body: { score: 71, noise: 3 } },
    '/my-plugin/apply': () => ({ status: 201, body: { score: 92 } }),
  }),
});

await panel.click('[data-testid="optimize"]');
console.assert(panel.text().includes('92'), 'the score on screen did not move');
console.assert(panel.must('[role="status"]').textContent.includes('92'));
await panel.unmount();
```

`unmount()` is async: it lets React finish the work its own unmount schedules before the DOM goes away. Skipping the `await` surfaces as `ReferenceError: window is not defined` *after* the test has already passed, which is a confusing way to learn it.

What you get back: `text()`, `html()`, `query(selector)`, `must(selector)` (throws with the rendered HTML when it misses), `click(selector)`, `type(selector, value)`, `press(selector, key)`, `focus`, `attributes(selector)`, `snapshot(dir, name)` for a normalised DOM baseline, and `host` for assertions about what the bundle registered.

### Keep a visual baseline

The DOM is the baseline: normalising class order and whitespace gives a file that fails for the reasons a screenshot would — a lost label, a control that stopped rendering — and can be reviewed in a diff instead of by eye.

```js
import { expectSnapshot } from 'dsh-plugin-toolkit/testkit';

const panel = await mountClient({ file: 'client.js' });
expectSnapshot(panel.html(), '__snapshots__', 'panel');   // throws with the element that moved
await panel.unmount();
```

First run writes nothing: it tells you to re-run with `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`, so a baseline is always a decision, never a side effect. That rerun writes the normalised HTML and returns `{ status: 'written' }`; later runs return `same` or fail with the element that moved.

### Check what assistive tech sees

```js
panel.expectAria('[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]', { label: 'Protection', selected: 'true' });
assert.match(panel.must('[role="status"]').textContent, /Score moved 71 → 77/);
```

`expectAria()` compares the attributes a screen reader actually reads — `role`,
`label`, `live`, `selected`, `expanded`, `checked`, `pressed`, `disabled` — and
names the one that differs:

```
[aria-live="polite"]: expected aria text to be "9", but it is "0"
```

A missing attribute is reported as `nothing`, not as an empty string, because
those are different bugs. `panel.aria(selector)` returns the same object when you
want to assert on it yourself.

`must()` throws with the rendered markup when the selector misses, which is the difference between "the assertion failed" and "here is what the user actually got".

Every example below is a file in this repository, run by CI, and the output shown is the output it prints:

| Example | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `node examples/mount-a-bundle.mjs` | mount a real bundle, read the text, click, read it again |
| `node examples/route-stubs.mjs` | answer the routes a panel asks for, and assert on the requests |
| `node examples/baseline.mjs` | a DOM baseline compared on every run |
| `node examples/aria.mjs` | what assistive tech sees |

```sh
$ node examples/mount-a-bundle.mjs
Demo panel Count 0 0
Demo panel Count 1 1
```

```sh
$ node examples/route-stubs.mjs
Score 71
asked for: 1 route(s), undeclared route answers 404
```

To look at a bundle by hand:

```sh
npx dsh-plugin mount ./client.js            # print the text a user would see
npx dsh-plugin mount ./client.js --html     # print the markup
```

That is how the AIignore panel was checked before release: the real bundle, mounted in Node, against a stubbed `/aiignore/*`:

```
$ npx dsh-plugin mount ../ai-context-doctor/plugin/client.js
AIignore No workspace yet Could not read the report …
```

## Put the badge on a plugin that passes

If `verify` passes on your plugin, this badge says so and links back here:

```md
[![checked with dsh-plugin-toolkit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
```

It is a claim, not a decoration: add it only when `dsh-plugin verify .` exits 0.

## Start from the example

[`dsh-plugin-example`](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-example) is a ~70-line plugin: one sidebar tab, two languages, one behaviour test, CI that runs `verify` through the composite action. It is the shape this toolkit expects, so it is also the fastest way to see whether the toolkit fits your plugin. It is a GitHub template too: **Use this template** starts you on a plugin whose first publish already passes.

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-example
```

## See what is installed, and what the app loaded

`doctor` checks one folder you name. The question that actually gets asked is
"why is my plugin not in the sidebar?", and the answer needs three things at once:
what is installed, whether each installed copy is valid, and which of them the
running app actually loaded.

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
dsh-aiignore           0.37.1    loaded       ok
demo-panel             0.3.0     not loaded   ok  — dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json does not list it, and the loader mounts only listed bundles
                                            fix: add "demo-panel" to dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json (or run `dsh plugin add demo-panel`), then restart the app

1 installed plugin(s) are not in the running app:
```

"Not loaded" has three different causes, and `audit` names the one that applies
instead of offering a blanket restart:

- **Not in `dsh.profile.bundles`.** `pnpm add` (or `npm install`) installs the
  package but does not tell the loader to mount it. Add the package name to
  `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or run
  `dsh plugin add <name>`, then restart the app.
- **No `dsh.bundle`.** The package declares `dsh` but no patch file to mount.
  Add `dsh.bundle.patch` to its `package.json` and ship the patch file, then
  reinstall.
- **Listed, but the app predates the install.** The profile is already correct;
  restart the app once to read the new list.

Advisories (`engines.dsh`, README Requirements) are counted apart from problems:
the market index needs them, the loader does not, so they should not bury a plugin
that is actually broken.

`audit` exits `1` when an installed plugin has a hard failure **or** when the
running app did not load at least one installed plugin, so CI can gate on a
profile where the app silently skipped a plugin. It exits `0` when every
installed plugin is loaded and valid. If no graph was read (`--host` omitted),
the loaded column is `?` and only hard failures change the exit code.

Without `--host` the loaded column is `?`, because guessing would be worse than
saying nothing. Only packages that declare a `dsh` field are audited — the rest of
`node_modules` is ordinary dependencies, and auditing those is noise.

An installed package whose `package.json` cannot be read is the exception: the
`dsh` field that would mark it as a plugin is in the file that failed to parse.
If its name is still in `dsh.profile.bundles`, `audit` reports a `manifest`
failure naming the unreadable `package.json` and exits `1` instead of treating
the folder as an ordinary dependency. A truncated manifest from an interrupted
install therefore cannot make the plugin disappear from the report, and a valid
sibling plugin is still listed on the same run. The exception stays narrow: a
damaged `package.json` in a package that is neither in `dsh.profile.bundles` nor
readable enough to expose a `dsh` field is still an ordinary dependency and is
skipped, so one broken transitive install does not fail every audit.

## Edit a plugin that is already installed

The host already swaps a rebuilt bundle without a page reload: it watches each plugin's entry artifact and reports a `rebuilt` frame on `/plugins/events`. `dev` puts the new file where the host is looking, then **proves** the frame arrived instead of asking you to check by eye.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
```

![dsh-plugin dev printing the revision the app reported](docs/dev.gif)

*Recorded from a real run against the running app: the last line is the revision the app sent back on `/plugins/events`, not a message the tool printed on faith.*

```
demo-aiignore: /work/plugin/client.js -> ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-aiignore/client.js
initial: copied 163647 bytes at 1:18:43 AM
reloaded dsh-aiignore (rev e0c0230c4fc9)
watching /work/plugin
```

That last line is the whole point: the revision came back from the app's own event stream, so "it reloaded" is a fact, not a hope.

A plugin the running app never loaded cannot be reloaded, and the app says so by leaving it out of the graph it sends first. `dev` reads that graph, so a freshly installed plugin gets the sentence that fixes it instead of a timeout:

```
copied, but not confirmed: the running app has not loaded demo-panel, so it will not report a reload; restart the app once after installing it
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dest <dir>` | write into this installed copy instead of searching `~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/<name>` |
| `--entry <file>` | copy this file instead of `dsh.client.entry`, `client.js`, `lib/client.js` |
| `--build <command>` | run this before each copy (a failed build copies nothing) |
| `--host <url>` | confirm the reload against the app at this URL; without it the copy still happens and the tool says it is unconfirmed |
| `--once` | copy once and exit, for scripts |

Two things it does not do, because the host does not: React state inside the reloaded plugin is lost, and a failed swap does not roll back to the previous bundle.

## Use it in CI

The same checks run as a GitHub Action, so a tag cannot go out on a plugin that would not install:

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit@v1
  with:
    dir: plugin        # the folder holding the plugin's package.json
    command: verify    # pack it, install the tarball, mount the panel
```

`verify` is the default because it is the only check that reads what a user
actually installs: `doctor` reads the working copy, so a `files` list that
forgets `client.js` passes it and fails only after `npm i`.

`command: doctor` stops at the manifest checks (fast, no install), and
`command: index` audits `market/index.json` instead, failing on any version whose
`engines.dsh` is missing or is not a semver range. Pin `version:` if you would
rather not track the latest release.

## Check a plugin you have not cloned

The panel takes three kinds of input: a folder, `owner/repo`, or a GitHub URL.
A bare name is a search, not a guess — it asks GitHub, lists the matches with
their stars, and checks the one you pick. A repository is downloaded once as a
tarball into a temp folder, so nothing is cloned into your workspace and
nothing is installed.

The CLI reads a repository straight from the GitHub API:

```bash
dsh-plugin doctor --remote V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

```text
dsh-plugin doctor: 1 problem(s) in V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
  ⨯ engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"; declare the range you support, e.g. "engines": { "dsh": ">=0.2.0" }
```

That is the whole reason this mode exists: the plugin hub files failed installs
back into plugin repositories, and the report is a sentence — `plugin install
failed`, `plugin does not support the DSH version in use` — that never names a
file. Reading `package.json` over the API is enough to name it.

What it can see, and what it cannot:

- Manifest checks (`engines.dsh`, `files`, `dsh.client`, `exports`) run on the
  real `package.json`.
- File checks (does `exports["./client"]` point at a file that exists, does the
  root export `apply`) need the tree. A package that runs `prepack`,
  `prepublishOnly`, `prepare` or `build` publishes files it does not commit, so
  those checks are **skipped with a note** instead of calling a working plugin
  broken.
- Public repositories work anonymously, but GitHub allows 60 requests an hour.
  Export `GH_TOKEN` (or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) to audit more than one or two.

To check a whole list in one pass, put one `owner/repo` per line in a file and
pass it with `--from` (`-` reads standard input):

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt
```

Repositories are read four at a time by default. `--jobs N` changes that width;
values above `8` are capped at `8`, and `--jobs 1` walks the list one repository
at a time, the timing the command had before batching. The output — and the
`--json` array — still follows the input list, and every verdict is the one the
sequential run produced, so a diff between two runs compares repositories rather
than scheduling.

When GitHub answers `403` or `429`, the shared quota is gone, so the batch stops
starting new repositories and marks every entry it could not read as
`rate-limited` instead of `clean` or `unreadable`. If the response carries
`x-ratelimit-reset` (or `retry-after`), the reset time is printed with the
verdict, and the remaining entries are reported without another request.

### Will this plugin install on my DSH?

The seven compatibility reports all end with the same question. Add `--host
<version>` to a remote audit and it answers that question for one repository.
This is a real run against `L3n3L/dsh-resume`, a plugin whose declared range
stops before DSH 0.2.0, checked against the `0.2.2-alpha.3` canary from the
reports:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote L3n3L/dsh-resume --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
incompatible  L3n3L/dsh-resume  0.1.3 (host >=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0) [incompatible with dsh 0.2.2-alpha.3; declares ">=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0"]

summary: 1 repository — 0 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 0 rate-limited
```

The verdict comes first: `incompatible` means the range in `package.json` does
not accept the host, so the installer rejects the plugin before it unpacks it.
This run exits `1`. The same answer is reproducible without a GitHub request —
the manifest is checked in under `examples/compatibility-sample/`, and this
command feeds it through the real CLI path:

```sh
$ node scripts/compatibility-sample.mjs
```

(`npm run compatibility` runs the same script.) The test suite runs that
command and compares its output with the block above, so the sample cannot
drift from the formatter or from the README.

The line carries the range `package.json` declares and one of `compatible`,
`incompatible`, or `unknown` against that host version. `unknown` is the honest
answer for a missing or malformed range — there is nothing to compare — while a
range that excludes the host is `incompatible`, counted as failing, and exits
`1`. npm's pre-release rule is part of the answer: `>=0.2.0` does not accept
`0.2.2-alpha.3`, because a range only opts into a pre-release when it names one
of the same `major.minor.patch`. A canary host can therefore be `incompatible`
with a range that will accept the final release. The same flag works in the
batch mode, so one `--from` run answers the whole list:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
```

The compatibility flags are `--remote <owner/repo>` for one repository,
`--from <file>` for a list (`-` reads standard input), `--host <version>` for
the DSH version to compare against, and `--json` for the machine-readable
finding. `--jobs <n>` sets the batch width, and `--patch-dir <dir>` writes the
host-targeted repair for each repository that needs one. The help text lists
the same flags; a test fails if this section names a flag the CLI does not have.

`--host` still names the running app URL for a local `audit`; on `--remote` it
is the DSH version to compare against. With `--json`, each finding gains
`host` and `compatibility` beside `hostRange`.

Each repository gets one line with its verdict — `clean`, `failing`,
`unreadable`, or `rate-limited` — and the run ends with a counted summary:

```text
clean         demo/plugin  1.2.3 (host >=0.2.0)
failing       demo/broken  — engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"
rate-limited  demo/blocked — GitHub rate-limited this request (403) for package.json; set GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN to raise the limit; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z
rate-limited  demo/next    — GitHub rate-limited the batch before this repository was read, so it was not requested; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z

summary: 4 repositories — 1 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 2 rate-limited
```

The parenthesised count is the number of failed checks, not the number of failing
repositories: one repository that fails both `engines.dsh` and its client
declaration prints `1 failing (2 problems)`.

The command exits `1` when any repository is failing, unreadable, or
rate-limited, and `0` only when every repository in the list is clean. `--from`
also accepts the JSON evidence shape (an array, or an object with `rows`) that
the old shell loop printed, so an existing audit file can be replayed without
rewriting it.

### Measured throughput

The measurement uses the first eight repositories from the 3 November
install-failure list — `610la/dsh-notification-center`,
`Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit`, `ChongCyrus/Vibe-Mathematics`,
`CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote`, `Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model`,
`FSMargoo/dsh-at-file`, `FylarOpen/dsh-fylar-office-editor` and
`GraySilver/dsh-evolve-modes` — served from memory with a fixed 500 ms delay on
every API request. That makes the number reproducible on any host: it measures
the batch's scheduling, not GitHub's mood. Reproduce it with:

```sh
$ npm run benchmark
```

(`node scripts/benchmark-audit.mjs` runs the same harness without npm's banner.)
The tarball ships both that script and the list it reads, so the command runs in
a checkout and in an installed copy. The test suite packs the package, installs
the tarball into a temp directory and runs the documented command there;
[`docs/benchmark-tarball.md`](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/blob/main/docs/benchmark-tarball.md)
records the packaging gap this closes.

It runs the same list twice: `--jobs 1`, which is the loop the command used
before batching, and the default `--jobs 4`. Measured on this host:

| run | wall clock | seconds per repository |
| --- | --- | --- |
| before (`--jobs 1`) | 8.03 s | 1.003 s |
| after (default `--jobs 4`) | 2.01 s | 0.251 s |

The after run keeps four reads in flight, so eight repositories finish in two
waves and the per-repository cost falls from about 1.00 s to about 0.25 s. The
test suite reads this table and fails if the after number no longer matches the
default `--jobs` value, so changing the default cannot leave the claim behind.

For a CI job or a repair sweep, add `--json`:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt --json
```
[
  {
    "target": "V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions",
    "version": "0.3.0",
    "hostRange": ">=0.2.0",
    "failures": [],
    "notes": []
  },
  {
    "target": "demo/plugin",
    "version": "1.2.3",
    "hostRange": null,
    "failures": [
      {
        "check": "engines.dsh",
        "message": "engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as \"incompatible with dsh\"; declare the range you support, e.g. \"engines\": { \"dsh\": \">=0.2.0\" }"
      }
    ],
    "notes": []
  }
]
```

Every repository produces one object with `target`, `version`, `hostRange`,
`failures` (`{ check, message }`) and `notes`, and the command exits `1` when any
repository has a problem. With `--host <version>` each object also carries
`host` and `compatibility`. A rate-limited repository adds `rateLimited: true`
and a `rateLimit` object with the HTTP `status` and, when GitHub sent one,
`resetAt`; it is not marked `unreadable`. A network error is printed in `notes`
and still exits `1`: a repository the tool could not read is never repo

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-lead-mode

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Adds a Lead mode to DSH. One preset, two skills, one self-check command, two reminders.

The official Team runtime ships tools: `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `team_task_*`. When to delegate, whom to delegate to, how to wait for a result, how to write the closing message, how to merge several members' output: none of that is in the tools. This plugin adds that layer. It does not replace the official Team mode; it sits on top of it.

Once installed, the model works the way a Lead does: split the work, delegate it, accept the result. It delegates hands-on work instead of doing everything alone.

## What you get

Five things. None of them touch dsh itself.

| Capability | Entry point | What you do |
|---|---|---|
| Lead mode preset | "Lead 模式" in the preset list | Switch to it |
| Lead working method skill | `/skill lead-mode`; the model also loads it on its own | Nothing |
| Team digest skill | `/skill team-digest`; the model decides at wrap-up whether to write one | Nothing |
| Dependency self-check | `/lead-mode` | Run it when dependencies look wrong |
| Two upfront reminders | Automatic | Nothing |

Additive only. `cordis.patch.yml` holds exactly two `insert` rows: this plugin, and a new `lead-mode` preset. The official `standard` preset is untouched; the new one copies 21 of its rows field for field and swaps only the persona.

It registers no tools, listens to no agent lifecycle events, and intercepts no requests. `lib/index.js` writes to two registries only: `skills` (two entries) and `commands` (one), plus a single warn at startup. Uninstall the plugin and those entries are gone; official behaviour goes back to what it was.

The one place it can collide is a skill or command with the same name. If you already have `lead-mode` or `team-digest`, the host takes the first one it sees, warns, and ignores ours; a collision means we step aside.

### 1. The Lead mode preset

Switch to it and the session's model becomes a Lead.

The preset is the official `standard` preset row for row, all 22 of them, with only the persona replaced. No tool is dropped: bash, file read/write, search, web, todo, skill, goal, plan, compaction, subagent and workflow are all there.

So switching to Lead mode costs you no capability. It changes how the model works, not what it can do.

### 2. The Lead working method skill

A working method for splitting, delegating and accepting work, shipped inside the package.

It is not tied to the preset. Any session can load it, two ways:

- The model loads it when it judges the task needs it (the skill is marked model-invocable)
- You run `/skill lead-mode` yourself

It covers: agreeing on the goal before starting, making a delegation self-contained, keeping write scopes disjoint, the list/get/claim/complete flow for shared tasks, how to wait on teammates, where a teammate's model comes from, and doing the final verification yourself.

Two of those facts only show up when you read the runtime source:

| Fact | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| A teammate settling notifies you automatically, carrying its closing message | Finish your turn after delegating; you do not need to sit and watch |
| A task change does not wake an idle Lead | Do not count on "it marked the task complete, so I know"; that path only wakes a caller currently inside `wait_agent` |

So the skill's default is: finish your turn after delegating and let the notification wake you (the user sees progress immediately), and use one `wait_agent` only when the current turn cannot continue without the result. Never loop `wait_agent`, and never poll with repeated `list_agents`.

Tell the teammate to put the **deliverable in its closing message** — that message is what comes back to you with the notification.

### 3. The team digest skill

At wrap-up the team's output sits in N closing messages and N worklogs, with nothing merging them. This skill writes it into one `reports/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<effort>.md`.

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| When | Before the final answer, when the effort had 2 or more members, or ran 2 or more rounds |
| Where | `reports/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<effort>.md`, one path, written once at wrap-up |
| Six blocks | 结论 / 谁干了什么 / 验收证据 / 偏离与未验证 / 死路与决策 / 未决与下一步 (conclusion, who did what, acceptance evidence, deviations and unverified, dead ends and decisions, open items and next steps) |
| Source layers | Closing messages build the skeleton, worklogs add process detail, session logs as the fallback |

The six headings are fixed Chinese strings; an empty block says 无. Take the layers in order and stop at the first one that is enough. Details are in the `team-digest` skill.

### 4. The dependency self-check command

`/lead-mode` reports the current dependency state.

| Reported | Content |
|---|---|
| Team runtime | Mounted or not; its `maxMembers` when mounted |
| lead-mode preset | Registered or not |
| Missing pieces | The version-pinned install command |

Everything in place returns success. Anything missing returns error. Nothing is skipped silently.

### 5. Two upfront reminders

**When the session has no Team tools, it tells you to enable the official Agent Teams instead of letting the model work alone.**

Two channels:

| Channel | Who sees it | When it appears |
|---|---|---|
| First persona section | The model | As soon as you switch to Lead mode. It is section 0 of the system prompt |
| Startup warn and `/lead-mode` | You | When the Team runtime is detected missing |

Both say the same thing: without the `spawn_teammate` tool set, stop and tell the user what to install.

The model will not pretend it can delegate, and it will not pass `subagent` off as a teammate.

## Enable the Team runtime first

Lead mode delegates through `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, and `team_task_*`. Those come from the official dsh Team runtime, which this plugin does not ship.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.2-rc.1
```

**The version pin is required.** Without it npm resolves `latest`, which is 0.1.5-alpha.2 — built for 0.1.x hosts and it will not mount on a 0.2.2 host. `next` points at 0.2.2-rc.1, which is the correct one. The pin also has to equal your host version (`dsh --version`): the team packages pin exact `dsh-*` peers, so an older rc installs a peer set the newer host does not satisfy. Restart dsh afterwards.

Not sure whether it is installed? Run `/lead-mode` in dsh; it reports dependency state.

## Install this plugin

Two routes, pick one.

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add dsh-lead-mode
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode
```

Restart dsh afterwards, then pick "Lead 模式" in the preset list.

## Usage

Three steps.

**1. Switch to Lead mode.** Pick "Lead 模式" in a new session's preset list. The first system-prompt section becomes the Lead persona, and the reminder at its top goes in with it.

**2. Run `/lead-mode` to check dependencies.** This command delegates nothing; it only reports state. When something is missing it prints the version-pinned install command.

**3. Let the model work.** With the delegation tools in place, the model splits the work, delegates to teammates, and waits for all of them before wrapping up. Without them, its first move is to tell you to enable the Team runtime.

## Using the skills without switching presets

You do not have to touch your preset. Install the plugin, keep `standard` or whatever you already use, and run `/skill lead-mode` in any session to load the method; the model also loads it when it judges the task needs it.

One thing is missing: the upfront reminder lives in the persona, so it appears only under the `lead-mode` preset. Run `/lead-mode` once before you start to check the dependencies; it prints the version-pinned install command when the Team runtime is absent.

`team-digest` works the same way. It is not tied to a preset, any session can use it, and the model decides at wrap-up whether a digest is worth writing.

## Friendly link: dsh-context

This plugin only does Lead mode. Visualising Team state and comms is **dsh-context**'s job, and that is a separate project:

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Repository | https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context |
| Author | bowenliang123 |
| License | Apache-2.0 |
| Install | `dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add dsh-context` |

It does not ship with this plugin, and it is not a dependency of it. This plugin only points at it from the docs and the skill.

### Why point there at all

Tool calls read one at a time. `list_agents` gives one line of status; `team_task_list` gives task ownership. Seeing who is doing what, and who said what to whom, takes a page.

dsh-context adds a **Fleet / 编队** tab to every session (right of **Context**), and the right sidebar's **Context** panel carries the same card.

| Surface | Shows |
|---|---|
| Summary | Member status, live context, estimated cost, task progress |
| Agent Network | The current agent, its parents, every subagent, one card each |
| Fleet Members | Each member's role, model, latest reply, run time, steps, active task count |
| Tasks | Team tasks and subagent delegations together, grouped by owner, with blocked-by chains |
| Agent Comms | Who said what to whom. Team relays, mailbox deliveries, and the runtime's settlement notices |

Picking a member on the graph or the member board narrows Tasks and Agent Comms to that one agent. Opening a message in Agent Comms shows the full record: which session log it came from, its sequence, whether the runtime wrote the settlement notice or the child sent it, and the complete closing report.

The Lead mode skill names this entry point too, so the model points you here instead of restating progress itself.

## Required official bundles and versions

This plugin ships none of the packages below. The host or an official bundle provides them; this plugin only declares version requirements in `peerDependencies`.

| Package | Requirement | Provided by | When missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` | `0.2.2-rc.1` | You install it explicitly | Cannot delegate; `/lead-mode` returns error; startup warn |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh` | `>=0.2.2-rc.1` | Host | Will not install |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `^4.0.5` | Host | Will not install |
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `^3.18.5` | Host | Will not install |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` | `>=0.2.2-rc.1` | Host | Preset row does not take effect; `/lead-mode` reports unknown |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` | `>=0.2.2-rc.1` | Host | Skill not registered; startup warn |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` | `>=0.2.2-rc.1` | Host | `/lead-mode` not registered; startup warn |

The target host version is `dshTarget` in `package.json`: `0.2.2-rc.1`.

## Why the install command pins a version

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` has three dist-tags on npm:

| dist-tag | Version | Host it fits |
|---|---|---|
| `latest` | 0.1.5-alpha.2 | 0.1.x |
| `alpha` | 0.2.2-alpha.3 | an earlier preview of the 0.2.2 line |
| `next` | 0.2.2-rc.1 | 0.2.2 |

Bare package name resolves `latest`, which installs 0.1.5-alpha.2. That build targets 0.1.x hosts and does not mount on a 0.2.2 host. After installing it, no Team tools appear in dsh and `/lead-mode` still reports "not mounted".

Measured on 2026-10-26 with npm 11.20.0:

```
$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile version
0.1.5-alpha.2
```

So every install command in this plugin carries `@0.2.2-rc.1`: the persona prefix, the `/lead-mode` output, the startup warn, and SKILL.md. `test/preset.test.mjs` and `test/smoke.test.mjs` both assert that string, so a future edit cannot quietly drop back to the bare name.

`next` now points at `0.2.2-rc.1`, the build this plugin pins; `alpha` (`0.2.2-alpha.3`) is an earlier preview of the same line.

## Difference from the official standard preset

One place only: the persona. The other 21 rows are copied field for field from `standard`.

| Item | standard | lead-mode |
|---|---|---|
| persona prefix | `You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.` | Chinese Lead persona plus an Agent Teams precondition check |
| other 21 rows | — | identical to standard, field for field |

The three classic subagent rows (`tool-subagent-control`, `tool-subagent`, `tool-subagent-fork`) stay enabled. `list_agents` now comes from `tool-subagent-control` itself, so there is no separate row for it. Nothing is disabled. The Team tools are a host decision, not a preset decision.

## Why the preset does not carry the Team runtime

`apply()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team` listens on the global `agent/created` event and installs Team tools on every agent. It is a host-plane plugin; putting it in a preset would leak it into every session.

So this plugin stays at: preset, two skills, reminder. Whether the Team runtime is on is decided by the user through the official profile package.

## Layout

```
package.json            package metadata; dsh.bundle.patch points at cordis.patch.yml
cordis.patch.yml        two insert rows: this plugin and the lead-mode preset
lib/index.js            host half: scan skills/, register each one, register the command, startup check
skills/lead-mode/       the Lead working method
skills/team-digest/     the team digest method
dsh-plugin.naming.json  naming manifest
test/                   behaviour assertions, zero dependencies
```

## Development

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
node --test test/*.test.mjs
node scripts/check-patch.mjs
```

Tests are zero-dependency. No `npm install` needed. The directory form of `node --test` is accepted only on Node 22+; on Node 20 the shell expands the glob.

## Releasing

Push a tag to trigger `.github/workflows/release.yml`. Publishing goes through npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC). No token is stored and no 2FA prompt appears.

Configure the Trusted Publisher once on npmjs.com:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Organization or user | `xiebaiyuan` |
| Repository | `dsh-lead-mode` |
| Workflow filename | `release.yml` |
| Allowed actions | Tick `npm publish` |

`npm stage publish` is allowed by default. With only that ticked, CI can stage but a human still has to approve before the version goes live.

Once configured:

```bash
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
git commit -am "chore: bump to 0.1.3"
git tag v0.1.3
git push origin main --tags
```

The tag version must equal `package.json`'s version, or the workflow exits without publishing. npm rejects a second publish of the same version, so bump the version every time.

## License

MIT

# dsh-video-kit 视频理解插件

把视频整理成时间线、镜头分组和可回查网格页，供 DSH Agent 浏览与核验。

## 能力

插件注册两个工具：

### `video_analyze`

输入本地视频路径或 Bilibili 视频链接（支持 `b23.tv` 短链），返回视频时长、内容组、字幕时间线（硬字幕 OCR + ASR 台词）、输出目录和索引路径。两条识别链的默认开关由**侧栏面板**决定（见下节）；工具参数显式传了则以参数为准：`subs` 控制硬字幕 OCR，`asr` 控制语音识别。

返回值里 `subsCount` 只统计 PP-OCR 硬字幕，`asrCount` / `asr` 是语音台词，两者互不代表 —— 硬字幕为 0 不等于视频没声音。

当前**不支持任意 HTTP 直链**。URL 视频会下载到临时目录，分析结束后临时视频会删除。

### `video_frame`

按时间点截取原始帧，可选裁剪与缩放。输入本地视频路径或 Bilibili 链接；传链接时会重新下载视频后取帧。结果以文件路径返回，可用 DSH 的 `read_image` 打开。

建议流程：

1. 调用 `video_analyze` 浏览时间线与组级导航图。
2. 对不确定的字幕或动作，调用 `video_frame` 定位原帧，或用 `read_image` 打开对应网格页。
3. 将 OCR/ASR 视为候选文本；关键文字、数字和动作细节要回看核验。

## 侧栏面板

侧栏「视频理解」（YouTube 样式图标）打开一个控制面板，开关就是 `video_analyze` 的默认行为：

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 硬字幕提取（OCR） | 用 PP-OCRv4 扫画面烧录字幕。约 0.5s/帧，纯人物画面通常一无所获 |
| 语音识别（ASR） | 本地 sherpa-onnx paraformer 识别台词；视频有配音却没烧录字幕时必开 |
| 基础抽帧率 | 1–12 fps，越高越细也越贵 |

配置存在 `storages/dsh-video-kit/config.json`（全机共用）。工具调用没显式传 `subs` / `asr` 就按面板走；面板改了配置，下一次调用即生效，不需要重启。

面板数据走 `/dsh-video-kit-api`：`GET /config`、`POST /config`、`GET /recent`（最近几次运行的时长/组数/字幕数/台词数）。这个路由是本机免认证的插件路由，跟 WebUI 的认证体系无关。

## 安装

要求 DSH Mobile、Node.js 20 或更新版本、ffmpeg、ImageMagick。

1. 将 `dsh-plugin/` 放进 DSH profile 的 `node_modules` 下（或使用 `link:` 安装）。
2. 安装插件依赖。包声明了 `onnxruntime-web`；若 DSH 的链接安装没有自动安装依赖，请在插件目录运行：

   ```bash
   pnpm install
   ```

3. 下载视觉模型。在插件目录运行：

   ```bash
   pnpm models
   # 或 node lib/videokit/download-models.mjs
   ```

   模型约 **47 MB**，保存到 `lib/videokit/lib/models/`。模型文件不随 Git 仓库分发，也不应提交进仓库。

4. 在 DSH 中执行 `install_bundle target="link:<插件绝对路径>"`，然后重启引擎。插件不支持热重载。

ffmpeg / ImageMagick 若不在引擎的 `PATH` 中，插件会探测 DSH 扩展目录；也可通过 `FFMPEG_BIN` 指定 ffmpeg 可执行文件。

### 可选：ASR

`asr: true` 需要额外安装 sherpa-onnx 和中文 Paraformer 模型（约 217 MB）。模型路径与运行时配置见 `lib/videokit/asr.mjs`。这部分不包含在上述视觉模型包中。

## 数据目录

默认目录为 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-video-kit/`，可用 `DSH_VIDEO_KIT_DIR` 覆盖：

```text
dsh-video-kit/
├── out/        # index.json、base/extra 采样帧、grids、可选 subs/audio
├── frames/     # video_frame 截取的原始帧
└── downloads/  # 分析/取帧期间的临时下载，完成后清理
```

`video_analyze` 的 `out` 参数只接受单级目录名称，产物始终写入插件存储目录下的唯一子目录。`video_frame` 的 `outDir` 也只接受存储区内的子目录名称。

## 数据与网络

- 本地视频由设备上的 ffmpeg、ImageMagick 与 ONNX 模型处理，不会上传到远程推理服务。
- 输入 Bilibili 链接时，插件会访问 Bilibili 短链/API，并下载对应视频流；该路径需要网络。
- 首次准备模型时，从 Hugging Face 与 PaddleOCR 的 GitHub 原始文件地址下载约 47 MB 的模型和字典。
- 临时视频下载会在分析/取帧结束后清理；生成的网格、索引和截帧保存在 DSH 本机存储中，直到用户自行删除。

## 实测记录

2026-10-25 的一段 95 秒竖屏 Bilibili 视频测试：耗时 262 秒（含下载、TransNet 检测和 PP-OCR），得到 13 个内容组、28 条字幕和 87 张网格页。OCR 曾将「逗AI真好玩」识别成「逗A真好玩」。这是单次测试记录，不代表其他设备或视频的性能与准确率。

2026-10-30 修复一处 OCR 全灭的坐标 bug：`subs.mjs` 的几何阈值原按 `ffprobe` 原始分辨率（1280×720）计算，而送检帧是 `scale=960:-1` 缩到 960×540 的，字幕框落在这套坐标里 —— `w > W*0.3`(384) 与 `y0 > H*0.65`(468) 对实际 `w=192 / y0=450` 的字幕恒为假，整片 420 帧输出 0 条。改为按帧坐标判定（宽 >8%、字高 2%~16%、下方 40%、水平居中），并加居中度挡掉角标水印。同一视频前 1/3（70s）实测：修复前 0 条，修复后 20 条，置信度 0.94~1.00。

同日加「预探测」：全量 OCR 前先均匀抽 12 帧试一遍，一帧字幕行都没有就直接收工（12 帧约 6s，换来省掉整轮全量）。实测 15 秒无字幕片：命中 0，9.7s 返回 0 条；有字幕片照常放行（20 条，73.9s）。可用环境变量 `SUBS_PROBE_N=0` 关闭。

同日调 ASR 切分（`asr.mjs`）：

- **超长段等分**（`ASR_MAX_SEG`，默认 25s）。paraformer 是整段一次性解码，喂 80 秒以上会明显跑偏。实测 210s 动画片：原来切出 86s/124s 两段、文本出现「冻筷子」「滑管」，切成 25s 以内后变成 **13 条 / 87.4s**（原来 8 条 / 120s），「我替你们每个人保管过一些东西」这类句子也捞回来了。
- **语气词过滤**：底噪/音乐常被硬识别成「啊」「啊啊」「嗯」，现在直接丢弃（实测实拍片少 1 条噪音）。
- **静音阈值可调**（`ASR_SILENCE_DB`，默认 30；`ASR_MIN_SILENCE`，默认 0.4）。实拍片人声轻时可放宽到 35：30s 实拍样本 3 条 → 5 条；但同一放宽用在动画片上反而少 4 条（段被合并过长），所以默认保持 30。
- 修掉一个 `Number(null) === 0` 的坑：最后一段 `end: null` 表示「到结尾」，原判定会把它算成 0 秒而跳过切分。

## 架构与许可证

完整的视频处理代码位于 `lib/videokit/`，根目录工具包与 DSH 插件内置副本需要保持同步。插件包采用 MIT 许可；模型权重有各自的许可条款，请在使用前核对。

# Video Understanding Kit

**Video Understanding Kit** 将视频转换为带时间戳的采样帧、镜头分组、网格图和可选的字幕/语音转写，供 AI 快速浏览并回查画面证据。项目同时提供命令行流水线和 DSH 插件。

> 项目主要面向 DSH 环境。桌面、服务器及其他 Android 环境尚未完成系统验证。识别结果用于定位候选内容，关键画面、文字和台词仍应回看核验。

## 工作流程

![Video Understanding Kit 工作流程](workflow.svg)

基础流程抽取视频帧、检测镜头边界、生成分组和网格页。硬字幕 OCR 与语音 ASR 可分别启用；启用 ASR 时，TransNet 镜头检测可在 worker 线程中与主线程工作重叠。镜头边界和帧差只用于时间导航，不代表语义场景或动作结论。

## 能力

- **镜头时间线**：TransNetV2 检测镜头边界，并把采样帧整理成内容组。
- **网格与证据回查**：输出网格页、组级导航图、源帧 ID 和时间戳。
- **硬字幕 OCR（可选）**：PP-OCRv4 从画面中提取烧录字幕候选，并标记需要复核的文本。
- **语音 ASR（可选）**：通过本地 sherpa-onnx Paraformer 识别台词并输出时间戳。
- **补充取帧**：可根据时间点重新提取原始帧；Bilibili 输入支持直接下载分析。
- **DSH 插件**：提供 `video_analyze`、`video_frame` 两个工具和一个侧栏面板。面板可设置 OCR、ASR 默认开关及基础抽帧率，并管理模型文件。

OCR 字幕和 ASR 台词是两条独立的识别结果。硬字幕数为 0 不代表视频没有语音；语音转写也不能代替画面核验。

## 环境要求

- Node.js 20 或更新版本
- pnpm
- FFmpeg、ImageMagick
- 使用 DSH 插件时，需要可运行 Cordis 插件的 DSH 环境

## 安装模型

在仓库根目录安装依赖并下载镜头检测和 OCR 模型：

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run models
```

视觉模型约 47 MB，下载到本地模型目录，不随 Git 仓库分发。首次下载需要网络连接。

### 可选：语音识别

ASR 还需要 sherpa-onnx 运行时和中文 Paraformer int8 模型，模型约 217 MB。它与视觉模型分开下载；未准备运行时和模型时不要启用 `--asr`。详细说明见 [asr.mjs](asr.mjs) 和 [DSH 插件文档](dsh-plugin/README.md)。

## 命令行使用

```bash
# 生成镜头分组和网格
node pipeline.mjs --video video.mp4 --out out

# 同时提取画面硬字幕
node pipeline.mjs --video video.mp4 --out out --subs

# 启用语音识别（需要 sherpa-onnx 和 Paraformer 模型）
node pipeline.mjs --video video.mp4 --out out --asr

# 同时启用 OCR 和 ASR
node pipeline.mjs --video video.mp4 --out out --subs --asr

# 强制串行运行 TransNet，用于对照或排查 worker 问题
node pipeline.mjs --video video.mp4 --out out --asr --serial

# 启动本地预览（默认读取 ./out）
node serve-preview.mjs out
# 打开 http://127.0.0.1:3329
```

CLI 中 OCR 和 ASR 默认关闭。输出目录非空时程序会拒绝覆盖；只有确认要清空该输出目录时才传入 `--force`。

常用参数：

| 参数 | 默认值 | 作用 |
|---|---:|---|
| `--video` | 必填 | 输入视频路径 |
| `--out` | `out` | 输出目录 |
| `--subs` | 关闭 | 启用硬字幕 OCR |
| `--asr` | 关闭 | 启用语音识别 |
| `--base-fps` | 5 | 基础呈现帧采样率 |
| `--diff-threshold` | 8 | 帧差候选阈值 |
| `--serial` | 关闭 | 禁用 TransNet worker 并行 |
| `--force` | 关闭 | 清空并覆盖已有输出目录 |

## DSH 插件

插件位于 [dsh-plugin/](dsh-plugin/)，提供以下工具：

- `video_analyze`：接收本地视频路径或 Bilibili 链接，返回时间线、网格图片路径、OCR 字幕、ASR 台词和分段耗时。
- `video_frame`：按时间提取原始帧，支持裁剪和缩放。
- **侧栏「视频理解」**：设置 OCR、ASR 默认值及 1–12 fps 的基础抽帧率，也可下载或删除模型。

插件支持 Bilibili 链接（含 `b23.tv` 短链），暂不支持任意 HTTP 直链。通过链接分析的视频会下载到临时目录，处理完成后清理。具体安装步骤、配置项和数据目录见 [插件说明](dsh-plugin/README.md)。

## 输出结构

```text
out/
├── index.json   # 时间线、分组、OCR/ASR 候选、边界、耗时与检查结果
├── base/        # 基础采样帧
├── extra/       # 候选区间的补充帧
├── grids/       # 网格页与组级导航图
├── subs/        # 启用 OCR 时的中间帧
└── audio/       # 启用 ASR 时的音频
```

`index.json` 中的 `groups[].pages[].frames[]` 记录每个格子的时间戳、源帧 ID 和提取 ID；`timings` 记录各处理阶段耗时。

## 性能与边界

0.2.2 的性能优化包括：TransNet 窗口步长从 50 调到 100，测试素材的切点结果保持一致；TransNet worker 与主线程处理重叠；补帧和网格拼图改用并发进程池；Bilibili 下载改为分片并发。15 秒测试素材上，TransNet 并行对照平均总耗时从 24.4 秒降至 20.1 秒；这只是 vivo V2405A 上的小样本结果，不代表其他设备的运行时间。ASR 与 TransNet 并行时会争用 CPU，ASR 本身可能变慢。

当前系统不保证准确识别所有动作或文字：

- 低帧率采样可能错过很短的动作、镜头或字幕。
- 帧差峰值可能来自转场或镜头运动，不能直接当成动作发生时刻。
- 网格适合浏览和定位；快速动作可能因为关键帧没有采到而无法判断。
- OCR 与 ASR 可能漏字、错字或漏掉台词；专名、数字和关键语句请回看原帧或音频。

关于采样策略和性能取舍的实验记录见 [ADR 与实验索引](docs/README.md)。项目的演进记录见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 开发与同步

根目录的 `pipeline.mjs`、`subs.mjs`、`asr.mjs` 和 `lib/` 是视频处理代码的真源；插件内对应副本由同步脚本生成。

```bash
pnpm run sync        # 更新插件内的处理代码副本
pnpm run sync:check  # 检查副本与真源是否一致
```

修改处理逻辑后，请同步副本并运行 `sync:check`，再提交两处代码。

## 模型与许可

程序代码采用 MIT 许可。TransNetV2、PP-OCRv4、相关字典和 ASR 模型各有自己的许可条款；使用前请分别核对模型及权重许可。

- [TransNetV2](https://github.com/soCzech/TransNetV2)
- [PaddleOCR](https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR)
- [sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx)

MIT code and documented nested local installation identify a real DSH plugin. No versioned host compatibility contract is established; dsh.version is the plugin version, not a host support range. The host invokes ffmpeg/ImageMagick and its local pipeline, installs dependencies when needed and downloads TransNetV2/PP-OCR/ASR assets. README explicitly leaves model-weight licenses separate, so model identity/license scope and companion artifact mapping remain unresolved. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-typing-practice A typing practice page for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI: English, Chinese and Cantonese text, recent local conversation passages, native IME input, Pinyin and Jyutping hints, live speed and accuracy, local best scores, practice history and optional mechanical keyboard sounds. 给 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 加的「打字练习」插件：英文、中文和粤语文本练习，可选默认语料或近期本地对话，使用自己的输入法上屏，可查看拼音或粤拼提示，实时统计速度与准确率，提供机械键盘音效选择，最佳成绩和练习历史存在本机浏览器。 > 非官方项目，只是一个 DSH 插件 bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`）。 ## 功能 | 项 | 说明 | |---|---| | 入口 | 左侧栏「打字练习」（键盘图标）→ 主区域练习页 | | 语料 | 英文生成句子、简体中文短文、繁体粤语短文；与界面语言独立 | | 本地对话 | 按当前语言，从当前 DSH profile 近 30 天的用户消息和已完成模型回复中选取片段；无结果时回退到默认语料 | | 来源切换 | 「默认语料／本地对话语料」位于「换一段」旁；记住选项，重新打开页面时恢复；回退不改变选项 | | 注音 | 中文带声调拼音、粤语数字声调粤拼；默认「当前词」，可选「全部」或「关闭」 | | 模式 | 默认语料为 15 / 30 / 60 秒限时；本地对话为「完成一段」，不计入限时最佳 | | 实时反馈 | 英文四行、中文和粤语三行视区；逐字符高亮，组字预览，计时条与剩余时间 | | 成绩 | 英文用 WPM，中文和粤语用字/分钟（CPM）；另显示准确率、正确字符和错误数 | | 最佳成绩 | Cream、Holy Panda，提供音量和试听，记住选择 | | 操作 | 首次有效组字或直接文字输入开始计时；上屏后判分；原生退格、选区替换；始终可见的重开按钮 | | 键盘导航 | `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 依次切换记录、音效、来源、换一段、语言、时长、注音选项、输入区与重开按钮；`Enter` / 空格激活按钮；记录与音效窗口可用 `Esc` 关闭并恢复焦点；组字时候选操作交给输入法 | | 界面 | 中英双语，跟随 DSH locale；只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，亮/暗色自适应 | 达到所选时长时即截止，之后的文字确认和退格都不计入本轮成绩，即使浏览器尚未执行下一次计时回调。截止时仍在组字的内容不进入成绩；旧输入框迟到的组合事件不会写入重开后的新一轮。界面优先使用宿主翻译；缺少翻译时，按 `getLocale().active` 选择内置中英文文案。 页面打开时保留宿主焦点。切换语料语言或时长会开始新一轮，焦点留在该按钮；重开按钮将焦点送回输入区。输入区有可见焦点框，输入、退格、重新聚焦和视区尺寸变化时会滚动到当前字符，保留相邻行作为上下文。原生输入元素跟随当前字符定位，为系统候选窗提供锚点。持续输入和退格只滚动文本视区；聚焦或缩放时，如输入区已离开可见范围，页面会滚动以显示整个输入区。重开会回到文本开头。 选文加载与回退提示使用语料栏中的固定位置。输入区未聚焦时，卡片底部显示「点击或用 Tab 聚焦后输入」；聚焦后在同一位置显示计时规则，不覆盖正文。注音下拉框保留原生键盘操作，并单独为文字和箭头留出间距。布局测量见 [UI 微调验证记录](docs/validation/2026-11-06-ui-polish.md)。 英文练习文本由常用词和标点本地生成。中文与粤语分别有六段原创短文，按完整句子循环补足限时语料。粤语内容使用「返屋企」「落緊雨」「傾偈」等粤语表达，使用者可以自行选择拼音、粤拼、仓颉等输入法。当前严格比较原文，不自动转换简繁或中英文标点，也不删除输入法自动补全的成对标点。语料不联网获取。 拼音由 `pinyin-pro` 生成，粤拼采用与 jyut 项目相同的 `to-jyutping` 引擎，结合词语上下文选音。注音在汉字上方显示；「当前词」会随输入位置移动，并保留隐藏注音的位置，避免每输入一个字就改变换行。自动注音不改写原文，未知读音留空。切换提示档位会保留当前语料并开始新一轮，三个档位的最佳成绩分别保存。 两个词库随插件打包，按所选语言在本地加载并缓存，不调用远程注音服务。首次准备注音期间暂不接收输入、不启动计时；加载失败时可重试，或关闭提示继续练习。 ### 本地对话语料 在「换一段」旁选择「本地对话语料」，插件立即按当前英文／中文／粤语模式选取文本。之后点击「换一段」可重新选取。切换语言、重新打开练习页时，也会按保存的来源选取；首次使用默认为「默认语料」，不读取聊天正文。选择默认语料会取消正在进行的读取。 本地对话只使用近 30 天的用户正文和已完成的模型回复，不区分两种来源。英文片段为 40–100 词，中文和粤语为 80–200 个可见字符，按完整句子选取。保留原文字形，不把普通话改写成粤语。没有合适内容、读取失败或超时时，自动使用默认语料，并保留「本地对话语料」选项，下次「换一段」仍尝试本地对话。读取中可点击「取消选取」。 提取会跳过推理、工具调用及结果、系统上下文、代码、表格、附件和明显的密钥等片段；清理 Markdown 后只显示普通文本，不执行内容。各消息分别提取，不拼接不同消息。完成片段后显示实际用时和成绩，重开保留同一片段；片段正文不持久化，也不进入限时最佳记录。 速度按当前正确匹配的可见字符计算：英文每五个字符折合一词；中文与粤语每个可见字符计一字，包含标点及拉丁字符。组字和选词时间计入用时。准确率按累计确认输入计算；取消组字不计错误，修正已上屏错误不抹去累计错误。使用 `Intl.Segmenter` 划分可见字符，避免把非 BMP 汉字或组合字符拆成多个计分单位。提前打完会显示实际用时，不写入完整时长最佳。 ### 键盘音效 点击右上角「音效」，选择声音并点击「试听」，用音量滑块调整大小。默认关闭，初始音量 30%；音色和音量随选择保存。练习进行中暂时禁用设置入口，结束或重新开始后可调整。窗口沿用页面的主题、原生下拉框与焦点样式。 首批四套声音来自 [kbsim](https://github.com/tplai/kbsim) 的 MIT 许可录音。每套含五个普通键变体，茶轴、奶油轴和 Holy Panda 另有空格、退格和回车录音；青轴的特殊键使用普通键录音。这些是具体键盘配置的录音，不代表所有同名轴体的声音。29 个原始 MP3 共 67,240 字节，保留原文件及校验值，构建后随本地 `client.audio.js` 分块按需加载。来源、版本和许可见 [素材说明](assets/audio/kbsim/README.md)与[第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 仅练习输入区聚焦且可输入时响应按键。忽略长按自动重复、导航键和带 Ctrl／Command／Alt 的快捷键；组字期间按浏览器实际收到的按键播放，上屏一整词不会按汉字数量重复响。普通回车不播放，组字回车可使用回车录音。声音与计时、判分独立，不另加错误提示音或抬键声。失焦、切到后台、重开或结束会停止播放。 音频在用户选择、试听或聚焦输入区后初始化，不在页面加载时自动播放。首次加载期间的按键不会排队补播；播放失败不影响练习，可在音效窗口中点击「试听」重试。同类应用参考和本轮验证范围见[音效验证记录](docs/validation/2026-11-06-keyboard-sounds.md)。 ## 安装 本插件是 DSH 的 bundle。克隆后，在 DSH 里让 agent 用 `plugin_manager` 安装**这个目录**： ```bash git clone https://github.com/yishan/dsh-typing-practice.git ``` ``` plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-typing-practice") ``` 如果你的环境里有 `dsh` CLI，也可以直接： ```bash dsh plugin --profile add /absolute/path/to/dsh-typing-practice ``` 安装后刷新 DSH Web 页面，左侧栏会出现「打字练习」。仓库包含已构建的注音与音效文件，直接安装无需自行构建；包管理器会安装 Host 所需依赖。注音分块和本地对话接口已在 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 验证；缺少对话查询服务时回退到默认语料，不具备相同模块加载能力的宿主可关闭提示使用。已有本地安装更新 Host 代码后，可在插件管理页关闭再开启「打字练习」。安装是 profile 级的，该 profile 下所有会话可见；删除时用 `plugin_manager` 卸载即可。 ## 数据 最佳成绩和练习历史统一写入 `dsh.typing-practice.v3`，其值为以下结构的 JSON 字符串： ```js { version: 3, best: { "en:30:builtin:plain:2": { speed: 76, accuracy: 0.94, at: 1793900000000 }, "yue:30:builtin:plain:2": { speed: 102, accuracy: 0.98, at: 1793900000000 }, "zh:30:builtin:current:2": { speed: 108, accuracy: 0.97, at: 1793900000000 }, "yue:30:builtin:all:2": { speed: 96, accuracy: 0.99, at: 1793900000000 } }, legacy: {}, // 旧版 v1 最佳单独保留，不参与新版比较 history: [{ id: "generated-run-id", language: "en", hints: "off", rules: 2, mode: "timed", source: "builtin", duration: 30, status: "completed", at: 1793900000000, elapsedMs: 30000, speed: 76, accuracy: 0.95, correct: 190, wrongKeys: 10, keystrokes: 200, targetLength: 1200, fingerprint: null }] } ``` 最佳成绩的键依次表示语言、秒数、内置语料、提示档位和评分规则版本。键中的提示档位使用 `plain`（关闭）、`current`（当前词）、`all`（全部）；历史条目的 `hints` 使用 `off`、`current`、`all`。`speed` 的单位由语言决定。比较时先看速度，速度相同时比较显示到整数百分比的准确率。 每轮结束只追加一次历史，按完成顺序保留最近 100 次。限时提前打完的条目标为 `early`，保存实际用时，但不更新限时最佳。中途重开、更换语料或离开页面不生成历史。本地片段条目使用 `mode: "passage"`、`source: "local"`、`duration: null` 和 SHA-256 文本指纹；仅与最近 100 次中相同原文、语言、提示档位和规则的成绩比较，不混比不同片段。限时最佳独立保留，不受 100 条历史上限影响。 首次读取时兼容 v2 最佳与 v1 旧版最佳，不补造过去的练习历史。下一次保存将有效旧成绩一并写入 v3，原始 v1／v2 数据不改写。旧版最佳单独显示，不参与新版比较。通过「记录 → 清空全部记录 → 确认清空」可一次清空历史及新旧最佳，保留语料来源选项；空的 v3 仍为有效数据，刷新不会重新导入旧成绩。手动删除 v3 会重新触发旧数据导入，因此请使用界面的清空入口。保存失败会提示，本页仍可查看尚未保存的成绩；清空失败则保留原记录。 语料来源单独保存在 `dsh.typing-practice.preferences.v1`：`{"version":1,"source":"local"}` 或 `{"version":1,"source":"builtin"}`。该设置与成绩分开；无效设置回退到默认语料。保存失败会提示，下次打开时可能需要重新选择。 音效单独保存在 `dsh.typing-practice.sound.v1`，例如 `{"version":1,"pack":"cream","volume":30}`；`pack` 可为 `off`、`mxblue`、`mxbrown`、`cream`、`holypanda`。清空练习记录不会清空音效选项。无效音色回退为关闭，无效音量回退为 30%。 本地对话模式通过当前 DSH Host 读取当前 profile 的聊天历史，不向外部服务上传正文，不调用远程模型或翻译服务。选中的片段只留在本次页面内存中；浏览器存储仅保留来源选项、成绩统计与片段指纹，不保存对话正文、标题、会话 ID 或消息位置。没有收藏、正文缓存或跨设备同步。 ## 结构 ``` dsh-typing-practice/ ├── package.json # bundle 清单 + dsh.client 声明（platform: web, inject: ["slots"]） ├── cordis.patch.yml # 只插入一行 Host 插件 ├── index.js # Host 半：注册受宿主鉴权保护的近期语料接口 ├── client.js # Client 半：侧边栏入口 + 练习页（手写） ├── client.pinyin.js # 生成文件：拼音引擎与对齐适配 ├── client.jyutping.js # 生成文件：粤拼引擎与对齐适配 ├── client.audio.js # 生成文件：音频播放器与四套按键录音 ├── assets/audio/kbsim/ # 原始录音、许可与固定版本的文件校验清单 ├── src/ # 注音、字符对齐、语料提取与接口、audio-player.js 音频播放器 ├── scripts/build.mjs # esbuild 打包为 DSH 异步模块 ├── tests/ # 输入、计时、记录、注音、语料、音效及偏好记忆测试 ├── icon.svg # 插件图标（原创键帽） ├── locale/{zh,en}.json # 插件管理页的标题 / 描述 ├── LICENSE ├── THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md └── README.md ``` 实现要点： - 挂载点：`sidebar.panellist`（`id: typing-practice`，order 15）+ `main`（`key: typing-practice`）。 - 计时、默认文本生成、成绩统计在浏览器端；Host 的 `GET /api/typing-practice/recent?language=en|zh|yue` 返回一个片段或回退原因。 - Host 使用当前 profile 的 `sessionQuery.listSessions` 和可取消的 `observeSession`；每次观察结束均释放。桌面 Client 优先使用宿主 `__DSH_TRANSPORT__.fetch`，Web 使用相对路径请求。 - `mdast-util-from-markdown` 在 Host 解析 Markdown。先过滤事件时间、来源和内容类型，再按句子边界选文；保留来源位置与指纹，接口不返回完整聊天日志。 - `client.js` 通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册，React 来自页面运行时；不 import 任何 Harness Client 包。 - 注音代码构建成两个独立的 DSH chunk，通过 `require.async` 按需加载。构建后更新主入口时间戳，使宿主刷新词库版本。 - 音效是独立的 DSH chunk，内嵌短录音；Web Audio 解码后缓存，最多叠加八个声音。音色切换、迟到加载与卸载均取消旧播放。 - 页面文案注册到 Client locale 服务，切换语言自动刷新。 ## 开发 - 改 `client.js` 后刷新页面即可；改 Host 入口或语料模块后，在插件管理页关闭再开启本插件，或重启 DSH。修改注音、音频源码、录音素材或依赖后，重新构建并一并提交生成文件与第三方声明。 - 静态检查： ```bash node --check client.js node --check index.js python3 -m json.tool package.json > /dev/null ``` - 安装开发依赖、构建注音和音效分块并运行回归测试（Node 内置测试运行器）： ```bash npm ci npm run build npm test ``` `npm pack` 会在打包前重新构建。运行这些开发命令需要包含 `src/`、`scripts/`、`assets/` 和测试文件的仓库 布局的检查见[本地语料验证记录](docs/validation/2026-11-06-local-corpus.md)。 记录窗口、刷新恢复、同篇比较、清空确认和窄屏的验证范围见[记录验证文档](docs/validation/2026-11-06-records.md)。 音效另在浏览器模拟宿主页验证了全部录音解码、四种音色的非零音频信号、逐键播放计数、选项恢复和中英窄屏布局。本轮未完成原生 DSH 的实际听音及真实 IME 期间的音效验收，详见[音效验证记录](docs/validation/2026-11-06-keyboard-sounds.md)。 ## 已知限制 - 当前已交付输入层、三语示例语料、拼音／粤拼提示、近期本地对话选文、最佳记录、练习历史和键盘音效。手动导入、收藏和自定义外观尚未实现，后续见 [多语言规划](docs/plans/2026-11-06-multilingual-practice-plan.md)。 - 每次最多检查 30 个会话，Host 使用 8 秒协作取消预算，Client 最长等待 12 秒；下次从后续会话继续。无结果表示本次预算内未找到，不保证遍历全部历史。宿主读取超大会话仍可能加载整份日志，预算不是严格的磁盘字节上限。 - 粤语识别使用用词特征初筛，可能漏选或误选；不保证所有片段的语言与自然度。不同宿主版本的历史格式可能需要适配，失败时回退默认语料。来源仅限当前 DSH profile，不读取其他应用历史。 - 自动注音和分词仍可能有误。内置粤语已为「慢慢行」「返到屋企」增加上下文读音校正；暂未提供用户选音、人工覆盖或读音教学功能。 - 内置语料规模较小，限时练习会循环使用；还需要扩充和人工审校。 - Windows、其他输入法，以及组字中跨行、缩放、截止等组合操作仍需真实环境回归。自动测试通过不代表所有输入法均已验证。 - 切换侧边栏面板会卸载页面，进行中的练习重置；已保存的最佳成绩和历史不受影响。练习进行中暂时禁用记录入口，结束或重开后可查看。 - 成绩只存在本机浏览器，不跨设备同步。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE)。随包注音依赖和键盘录音的版本、来源和许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 --- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. MIT repository/package, documented clone/local bundle installation, README DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 testing and same-commit manifest/patch are verified. Native host routes use Connection Fetch and bound concurrent reads, timeout, recent-session scans and prose length. Conversation practice is optional; it reads recent chat text with filtering, which is not a guarantee that all sensitive text is removed. Fixed local pinyin/jyutping/audio chunks and MIT/BSD notices are captured; scores/preferences stay in browser storage. prepack rebuilds the bundle but was not run. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 🖥️ dsh-idle-crt **十分钟没动静，给终端亮一块显像管。** DSH 闲着、并且超过设定时间没人碰鼠标键盘时，页面盖上一块 CRT 板——辉光字、扫描线、循环反色扫掠；在窗口里点一下或按个键就消失。

看一眼 · 快速开始 · 出现与消失 · 共存 · 配置 · 工作原理 · 性能 · 数据与信任 · 来源与致谢

简体中文 · English summary

--- > **来源声明**：本项目是 [justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt](https://github.com/justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt) 的**衍生改造（adaptation）**。 > 上游把它做成「启动一闪而过的 CRT 闪屏」，本插件把它改成「待机时才出现的屏保」， > 并补上了空闲检测、输入语义、与其它插件的共存层、设置页与 GPU 合成。 > 画面部分（CRT 着色器、反色扫掠、辉光字排版）源自上游，MIT 协议，版权归其作者。 > 详细改动与致谢见 [来源与致谢](#来源与致谢)。 ## 一眼 ![待机画面：一轮完整的反色扫掠](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzephyr920-oss/dsh-idle-crt/main/docs/plate-cycle.gif) 一轮完整循环 38 秒（预热 → 白色反色扫掠 → 停留 → 黑色反向扫掠 → 停留），这里 12.5 fps、560×315 抽样；真实画布是 60 fps 的全屏 GPU 合成。 | 预热瞬间 | 设置 → 待机屏保 | |---|---| | ![预热](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzephyr920-oss/dsh-idle-crt/main/docs/screenshot-warmup.png) | ![设置页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzephyr920-oss/dsh-idle-crt/main/docs/screenshot-settings.png) | ## 快速开始 要求：DSH **0.2 及以上**，浏览器端支持 WebGL（这机器上基本都满足）。 ```powershell # 1) 从 npm 装（推荐） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-idle-crt # 2) 或者直接链一个本地目录（改代码时更方便） dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:G:/DSH/dsh-idle-crt ``` 装完**重启一次 DeepSeek Harness**（客户端模块清单在启动时扫描），之后： - 想让画面现在出现：**设置 → 待机屏保 → 立刻看一眼**； - 想马上生效地调参数：设置页改完点「保存」，画面参数当场热更新； - 只想临时看效果、不装插件：`node tools/preview-server.mjs 8791`，打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8791/tools/preview.html`。 ## 什么时候出现，什么时候消失 **出现**（两个条件同时满足） 1. DSH 没有正在跑的活（`busy=false`）； 2. 距离上一次**页面内**输入超过阈值（默认 **10 分钟**），且标签页是可见的。 **消失** - **在窗口里点一下**、**按一个键**、触摸一下、右键一下 —— 立刻淡出； - 鼠标只是**移动**不算（默认如此）。这是刻意的：「动一下鼠标就收起」的老式屏保，在被远程桌面、被猫碰到的桌子上是灾难；配置里可改回老行为（`dismissOnMove`）； - 滚轮只锁住页面滚动，不收起画面——滚动一下往往只是「人在看」。 **不会出现的情况**：页面里有全屏元素、有打开的模态框（`aria-modal`）、有**面积 ≥ 视口 20% 的正在播放的视频**；标签页在后台。别的插件也可以主动按住它（见下节）。 ## 和别的插件共存 这类「全屏覆盖层」最容易跟主题、宠物、HUD 打架，所以这里是显式处理的： - **叠得上去**：挂载时量一遍 `body` 下所有大面积浮层的最大 `z-index`，取 `max+10`；之后 `MutationObserver` 盯新挂的层 + 每 500 ms 复查，别人的 HUD 后挂也会被追上（单调不回退）。收板后页面原状。 - **自动让路**：全屏、`aria-modal` 对话框、**占视口 ≥20% 的播放中视频**。小尺寸的装饰视频（例如宠物挂件那种 440×248 的循环动画）**不算**——否则屏保永远不出现。 - **合作信号**：板子盖着时 ``，别的动画插件可以据此暂停自己的动画；收板即清除。 - **请它让一让**：`window.__DSH_IDLE_CRT__.hold('reason')` / `.release('reason')`（成对使用），整页禁用用 `window.__DSH_IDLE_CRT_SUPPRESS__ = true`。 - **调试接口**：`__DSH_IDLE_CRT__.snapshot()`、`.show()`、`.hide()`、`.setBusy(v)`、`.setIdleMs(ms)`、`.activity()`。 ## 配置 设置页是「设置 → 待机屏保」；也可以直接写 `$DSH_HOME/idle-crt.settings.json`，或者改插件行配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）。 优先级：**设置页写下的文件 > 插件行配置 > 内置默认**。 | 键 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---|---| | `enabled` | bool | `true` | 总开关 | | `idleMs` | number | `600000` | 多久没输入才出现（ms），设置页按分钟填 | | `pollMs` | number | `1500` | 向宿主查询 busy 的间隔（ms） | | `fadeInMs` | number | `320` | 出现时的淡入 | | `fadeOutMs` | number | `600` | 消失时的淡出 | | `bootMs` | number | `1400` | 显像管「点亮预热」时长 | | `wipeStartMs` | number | `4000` | 画面出现后多久开始第一次反色扫掠 | | `wipeMs` | number | `14000` | 一程扫掠多久（白、黑各一程，交替循环） | | `wipeHoldMs` | number | `5000` | 每程扫完停留多久 | | `scanlineIntensity` | number | `1` | 扫描线强度 0–2 | | `promptText` | string | `PRESS ANY KEY TO CONTINUE` | 底部提示语（留空用默认，最长 80 字符） | | `dismissOnMove` | bool | `false` | 鼠标移动也收起（老式屏保行为） | ## 工作原理 两个半边： - **宿主半边**（`lib/index.js`）：订阅 `agent/status` 与 `api-session/status` 维护「哪些会话在跑」，并在每次 `state.json` 请求时用 `agents.list()` 重算一遍兜底；对外只暴露 `/dsh-idle-crt/{state,settings}.json` 与画面脚本。 - **浏览器半边**（`lib/plate.js`，自举脚本 + 一个独立客户端模块 `lib/client.js` 提供设置页）：控制器盯着输入与 `state.json`，够条件才挂载画面。 画面本身是一条 GPU 管线： 1. 文字（DEEPSEEK / HARNESS / TUI 行 / 底部提示 / 辉光 / 扫描线洞）在**挂载时**画进两张离屏图层，上传成两张纹理——只在窗口尺寸或提示语变化时重做； 2. 每帧只设几个 uniform、一次 `drawArrays`：预热斜坡、灯管闪烁、亚像素摆动、提示语渐显与呼吸、扫描线、滚动亮带、颗粒、暗角、RGB 色散、反色扫掠与青色边界、淡出，**全部在片元着色器里**； 3. 没有任何逐帧的 2D 绘制或纹理上传。 ## 性能 1440×900、6 秒稳态采样（rAF 间隔）： | 版本 / 路径 | 平均 | p50 | p99 | |---|---|---|---| | 0.1.4 每帧重画 2D（SwiftShader） | 90.3 ms | 83.4 | 150 | | 0.1.5 层缓存 + 隔帧上传（SwiftShader） | 41.4 ms | 49.9 | 83.3 | | **0.2.0 全 GPU 合成（SwiftShader，软渲染上限）** | **32.5 ms** | 33.3 | 50 | | **0.2.0 全 GPU 合成（RTX 4060 / ANGLE D3D11）** | **16.6 ms** | 16.7 | 16.8 | 真机上 p99 与 p50 相同——满帧 60 fps。复测：`node tools/diag-perf-gpu.mjs 8791 gpu`（会打印实际 renderer 名字）。 ## 开发 ```powershell npm install # 只装 esbuild（其余零依赖） node tools/build.mjs # src/client/index.js -> lib/plate.js node tools/preview-server.mjs 8791 # 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8791/tools/preview.html （可加 ?bare=1 / ?freeze=screen1:6 / ?idle=2） ``` 目录： ``` lib/index.js 宿主半边：busy 跟踪、设置读写、路由 lib/bootstrap.js 注入到页面 的自举脚本（只负责拉起画面脚本） lib/plate.js 画面脚本（esbuild 打包产物，改 src 后重新 build） lib/client.js 设置页（dsh.client 客户端模块，注册到 settings.section） src/client/index.js 画面源码 tools/ 构建、预览、验收、性能探针 ``` 验收脚本（都要带 base URL，桌面端每次重启端口会变）： | 脚本 | 验什么 | |---|---| | `verify-preview.mjs ` | 预览页：像素、反色、移动不收、点击收、busy 压制 | | `verify-gui.mjs ` | 真 GUI：出现、z 轴、marker、移动不收、点击收、页面仍可用 | | `verify-cycle.mjs ` | 一轮循环：键盘关→再现→移动/滚轮不关→点击关→hold/release | | `verify-compat.mjs ` | 共存：更高 HUD、模态框、大视频让路、小宠物视频不挡、SUPPRESS | | `verify-settings-gui.mjs ` | 设置页：字段、保存落盘、立刻看一眼 | | `diag-perf-gpu.mjs gpu\|sw` | 帧率与真实 renderer 名 | 重录 README 里的循环 GIF（画面被逐帧钉在时间轴上，不用屏幕录制，所以没有撕裂）： ```powershell node tools/preview-server.mjs 8791 # 另开一个窗口 node tools/record-gif.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8791 # 475 帧 → _frames/ python tools/gif-encode.py 560 64 none 1 # → docs/plate-cycle.gif（约 8.8 MB） ``` `python` 需要 Pillow；没有的话用 DSH 自带的 python（`dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/python.exe`）。 帧图只在本地，`_frames/` 已进 `.gitignore`。 插件页图标读的是包根的 `icon.svg`（`package.json` 的 `exports["./icon"]` 指过去），README 顶部用的是同一个文件—— 所以 GitHub 首页和 DSH 插件列表里看到的是同一枚显像管图标。 宿主路由（除调试路由外都在 `/dsh-idle-crt/` 下）：`state.json`、`settings.json`（GET/POST）、`client.js`、`bootstrap.js`； 调试用的 `auth-url.json` / `debug.json` / `diag` 仅回环可访问。 ## 数据与信任 - **不联网**：插件没有任何外发请求，画面与设置都在本机。 - **只写一个文件**：`$DSH_HOME/idle-crt.settings.json`（默认 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\idle-crt.settings.json`）。删掉它就回到内置默认。 - **调试路由只在回环**：`auth-url.json`（给无头测试换登录 Cookie）与 `debug.json`/`diag` 只在 `127.0.0.1` / `::1` 可用，非回环一律 403。 - 不动 DSH 本体、不注册全局快捷键、不改别的插件的 DOM。 ## 来源与致谢 **上游（本项目的来源）** - [**justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt**](https://github.com/justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt) —— MIT，CRT 画面、反色扫掠算法、辉光字排版均来自这里，作者 **justawebsite** 及其贡献者。 上游做的是「DSH 启动时一闪而过的闪屏」；本插件把它改成「闲置十分钟后才出现的待机屏保」， 保留上游的画面语言与着色器思路，重写了触发、输入、共存与渲染路径。 **本仓库相对上游的主要改动** 1. 触发：从「启动时无条件显示」改为「宿主 busy=false 且页面内闲置超阈值」，并去掉启动时隐藏页面的行为； 2. 输入：默认只有「窗口内点击 / 按键」才收板（上游是任意输入），滚轮改为只锁滚动，新增 `dismissOnMove` 开关； 3. 宿主：新增 busy 检测（`agent/status` + `api-session/status` + `agents.list()` 兜底）、设置持久化与 `state.json`/`settings.json`； 4. 新增一整页设置界面（`settings.section` 槽位），改完参数当场生效并落盘； 5. 共存层：z-index 动态爬升、全屏/模态/视频让路（含 20% 视口门槛）、`hold/release`、`data-dsh-idle-crt="active"` 合作信号； 6. 渲染：从「每帧重画 2D + 上传纹理」改为「图层一次上传 + 片元着色器逐帧合成」，真机 60 fps； 7. 工程：esbuild 构建、预览页、五套 Playwright 验收脚本与性能探针。 **致谢** - **justawebsite** 与 dsh-splash-crt 的贡献者：没有那块板就没有这个插件。 - **DeepSeek Harness** 与 Cordis 插件系统：`webserver/index-inject`、`settings.section`、`dsh.client` 这些入口让「不改本体」成为可能。 - 本机实测中与它同场竞技、也顺手暴露了不少坑的插件：**dsh-theme-mls-desktop**（主题壳与设置面板）、**dsh-pet**（小尺寸自动播放视频一度让它永不出现）、**billion-context / 上下文洞察**（大面积深色画布与浮层）、**dsh-better-display**（高 z-index HUD）。共存逻辑基本都是被它们逼出来的。 - 上游 README 里那份动画时间轴的说明，本项目的默认参数直接沿用了它的节奏。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)。上游同为 MIT；本仓库保留上游版权声明，衍生部分版权归 dsh-idle-crt contributors。
